title: Clinical Care Guidelines Collaboration with Primary Care
implementation_guidance: Establish a structured process for nurse care managers to collaborate with primary care providers by: 1) Documenting clinical and management issues identified during patient visits, 2) Providing specific guideline recommendations for diabetes management, 3) Sharing depression screening results and treatment recommendations, 4) Creating a standardized communication template for consistent information sharing, 5) Following up on recommendations that haven't been implemented.
expected_outcomes: Reduced clinical inertia, improved implementation of evidence-based guidelines, better coordination of care, enhanced communication between providers, more timely treatment adjustments, and improved clinical outcomes through team-based care.
target_population: Healthcare teams serving Medicaid-enrolled individuals with type 2 diabetes, particularly in settings with limited provider time or high patient complexity.
citation: Stuckey HL, Dellasega C, Graber NJ, Mauger DT, Lendel I, Gabbay RA. Diabetes Nurse Case Management and Motivational Interviewing for Change (DYNAMIC): Study Design and Baseline Characteristics in the Chronic Care Model for Type 2 Diabetes. Contemp Clin Trials. 2009;30(4):366-374. doi:10.1016/j.cct.2009.03.002.
